items.title: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
items.why_now: 免费Claude Code路由工具新增浏览器会话，每月1.3B免费token，独立开发者即刻白嫖多模型IDE编码环境。
items.why_now_en: New browser-based free Claude Code access is live now.
items.summary_en: free-claude-code (FCC) is an open-source tool that provides access to 12 coding harnesses (including Claude Code and Codex) and 61 providers, offering 1.3B+ free tokens per month with up to 90% token usage reduction via RTK and Headroom optimizations. It supports deployment across terminals, IDEs, mobile apps, and browsers while featuring automatic model fallback, concurrent execution controls, and local voice note processing using Whisper or NVIDIA NIM.

items.title: 李飞飞最新世界模型正式开放，我用它一句话造出重庆山城
items.why_now: World Labs今日开放Atlas世界模型API，新用户赠1万积分，3D生成工具链即时可用。
items.summary_en: World Labs has released its world model Atlas to the public, providing a complete 3D generation toolchain that includes image-to-scene creation via Viewfinder, natural-language environment building with Chisel, and Gaussian splat-to-mesh export for integration with game engines and Blender. The system utilizes the Gemini 4 Argon agent to execute multi-step scene construction, such as automatically building a detailed Chongqing cityscape with 38 steps and 9 camera positions, while managing geometry errors and rendering via a credit-based pricing model where users receive 10,000 credits upon signup.

items.title: 研究生如何用 AI 辅助完成一篇综述：我的科研写作工具与实践经验
items.summary: 作者利用 Gemini、Qwen、Zotero 及 WorkBuddy 构建工作流，独立完成了被《食品科学》录用的一篇食品领域综述论文。该流程涵盖使用 Gemini 优化选题与大纲、通过 Zotero 批量导出文献摘要供 Qwen 筛选、利用 ChatGPT 辅助绘制机理图以及 WorkBuddy 进行投稿格式检查，实现了从检索到成稿的全环节效率提升。
items.summary_en: A graduate student successfully published a review paper in the "Food Science" journal by leveraging an AI-assisted workflow that integrates Gemini for topic selection, Zotero and Qwen for literature management and abstract synthesis, and Keynote for figure creation. Key to the process is using structured "scientific prompts" to prevent AI hallucinations, specifically feeding high-density abstracts rather than full PDFs to improve data extraction accuracy, while maintaining human oversight for rigorous scientific judgment.

items.title: Claude Code Stop hook 技巧：用 exit code 2 让 Claude 在检查失败时自动重试
items.summary: Claude Code 的 Stop hook 通过区分退出码实现自动重试逻辑：使用 exit code 2 可将 hook 的 stderr 反馈给 Claude 触发重试，而 exit code 1 为非阻塞模式，检查失败时程序会直接结束。
items.why_now: Claude Code新技巧：exit code 2让检查失败自动重试
items.summary_en: In Claude Code, using a Stop hook with an exit code of 2 automatically triggers a retry by passing the hook's stderr back to the model, whereas an exit code of 1 is non-blocking and causes the process to terminate even if checks fail. This specific behavior allows developers to implement auto-retry workflows for failed validations.

items.title: Cursor 披露安全事件调查结果，恶意 Claude Code 扩展波及最多 5000 用户
items.summary: Cursor 披露安全事件调查结果，攻击者利用泄露的 Fireworks 访问密钥窃取数据，导致 Anthropic Claude Code 扩展的恶意副本被植入 VS Code 市场，波及最多 5000 名用户，仅造成少于 0.01% 客户 API 凭证及不到 0.05% 编码智能体追踪数据暴露。该恶意版本（2.1.312/2.1.313）于 10 月 29 日上线，11 小时后被移除，Cursor 已将所有推理流量迁离 Fireworks、轮换相关凭证并重建扩展市场以彻底阻断风险。
items.summary_en: Cursor disclosed that an attacker exploited a leaked Fireworks API key to access a read-only storage bucket, exposing coding agent traces for fewer than 0.01% of customers and resulting in up to 5,000 users potentially receiving a malicious, unauthorized copy of the Anthropic Claude Code extension (versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313) via the Cursor VS Code marketplace. The incident did not compromise Privacy Mode data, production infrastructure, or other marketplace extensions, though Cursor subsequently rotated all compromised credentials, migrated inference traffic off Fireworks, and rebuilt the extension marketplace to contain the threat.

items.title: I built a desktop app that clones your own voice locally, then reads text, whole audiobooks or dubs videos in it
items.topic: AI 工具实操 / Agent 工作流
items.why_now: 开源本地语音克隆工具Mimvox发布，实现零云端依赖的高保真配音。
items.why_now_en: Local 0.94-similarity voice cloning free on 8GB GPUs
items.summary_en: Mimvox is a free, locally-run desktop app that uses a stack of Rust, Python, and NVIDIA GPUs to clone a user's voice from roughly 6 minutes of reading, achieving 0.94 speaker similarity for text-to-speech in ~60 languages, video dubbing, and audiobook generation. The application supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, operates without cloud dependency, and achieves first sound generation in 1-3 seconds on an RTX 4070.

items.title: Crossed 3400 in revenue and hit 50 paying customers on day 98, and I wrote down how every single one of them found me
items.summary_en: ReelDrop.io, an Instagram scheduling and DM automation tool, has reached 52 paying customers from 21 countries and generated CA$3,410 in net revenue by day 98, with 39 of those customers subscribing to a $9.99/month tier. Key acquisition channels include Google search (17 customers) and direct referrals from personal emails or mentors, while a one-page documentation guide drove its first verifiable ChatGPT-referred customer. The founder identifies churn on the low-cost plan, ineffective paid UGC, and zero measurable signups from Reddit as current operational challenges.

items.title: 高难盲测超越GPT-6-Astra与Opus-5！无界前沿开源Fx-Bio-1031，把RSI带进生命科学
items.summary: 无界前沿开源生物信息大模型Fx-Bio-1031，采用125B总参数（每token激活6B）的MoE架构，支持本地私有化部署以确保数据不出域。在Anthropic BioMysteryBench困难子集中，其Pass@5达70.59%，较GPT-6-Astra（47.06%）和Claude Opus-5（52.94%）分别领先23.53和17.65个百分点；同时在BiomniBench基准中Pass@3达到89.50%，具备自主写代码、调数据库及交叉验证等复杂生信任务处理能力。
items.why_now: 无界前沿今日开源Fx-Bio-1031，填补国内生信模型空白并支持私有化部署。
items.summary_en: Wujie Frontier open-sourced the Fx-Bio-1031 model, a 125B parameter MoE architecture designed for local bioinformatics deployment, which outperformed GPT-6-Astra (47.06%) and Claude Opus-5 (52.94%) on Anthropic's BioMysteryBench difficult subset with a 70.59% Pass@5 score. The model achieves an 89.50% Pass@3 on BiomniBench and supports end-to-end scientific workflows, such as drug target validation and multi-omics analysis, through autonomous code execution, database querying, and cross-validation within a private sandbox environment.

items.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.summary: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋卸任导致AI初创资金环境生变，该公司今年参与了105轮融资，曾斥资130亿美元收购Hugging Face、向Reflection AI注资8亿美元，并深度投资CoreWeave、Mistral AI等核心标的。临时CEO Colette Kress被投资者认为风格更保守，预计将减少早期生态注资，可能削弱英伟达通过芯片绑定初创企业形成的垄断地位，并给Google等竞争对手提供市场空间。
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang’s departure as Nvidia’s CEO threatens the AI startup ecosystem, where Nvidia invested in 105 rounds this year, including an $800 million check to Reflection AI and a $13 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. Interim CEO Colette Kress is expected to adopt a more conservative approach to these massive investments in neoclouds and open-weight models, potentially creating a significant funding gap that rivals like Google may exploit.

items.title: 黄仁勋辞职，英伟达33年首换帅，市值蒸发超3万亿
items.summary: 黄仁勋辞去英伟达总裁、CEO及董事职务，结束其长达33年的执掌生涯，由现任CFO Colette Kress出任临时CEO，公司同时任命Harvey C. Jones为历史上首位董事会主席。受此消息影响，英伟达股价盘中最大跌幅达13.58%，市值蒸发超3万亿美元，但随后跌幅收窄至4.63%。董事会已启动正式CEO遴选程序，确认11月17日将如期公布2027财年第三季度业绩。
items.why_now_en: Nvidia's abrupt CEO exodus signals a critical market shift.

items.title: 破局硅谷头号难题！中国AI「魂穿」老电影，神器全民开放
items.summary: 中国具身智能独角兽维他动力（Vbot）发布跨视角生成模型Exo2EgoPolicy与端到端数据管线Vbot Echo，后者即日起向全民开放，用户仅需用手机拍摄第三人称视频即可自动转换为第一人称视角及三维手部骨骼数据。该模型以140亿参数为基底，零先验推理下视频生成FVD误差较开源基线EgoX降低39.8%，手部关键点定位精度（PCK@5%）从11.52%提升至20.02%，有效解决了具身智能领域训练数据缺乏多样性与规模化的行业难题。
items.why_now_en: Vbot just open-sourced its Exo2Ego data pipeline, letting anyone instantly turn internet videos into robot training data.
items.summary_en: China's robotics company Vbot has released the Exo2EgoPolicy model, a 14-billion parameter video generation architecture that converts third-person internet footage into first-person ego-view with precise 21-keypoint 3D hand skeleton data without requiring depth cameras. By integrating geometric constraints into its H3 Ref2VA DiT backbone, the model reduces Flow Matching error by 7.9% to 11.2% compared to baselines, achieving a 39.8% drop in FVD error and doubling hand keypoint localization accuracy to 20.02%. Vbot is simultaneously launching the Vbot Echo data pipeline and Echo App, which allow users to upload short smartphone videos to automatically extract ego-view trajectories and physical contact forces, effectively solving the data scarcity bottleneck for embodied AI by leveraging massive third-person internet video datasets.

items.title: Sierra 发布 Personal Agent Protocol（Poppy）v1.0
items.why_now: Poppy v1.0 正式开放且 Shopify 全量启用，独立开发者可即刻接入企业级智能体互操作标准。
items.why_now_en: Poppy v1.0 live, Shopify enabled for all merchants.

items.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
items.summary: llama.cpp 发布 v1.0.0 版本，确立了严格的语义化版本规则以保障 API 和 ABI 的稳定性，旨在为跨平台及隐私敏感的本地 AI 产品提供轻量且通用的基础设施。作为本地推理的核心引擎，该项目支持超过 150 种模型架构变体及主流推测解码方法，并兼容 NVIDIA、AMD、Qualcomm 等多厂商硬件后端，持续扩展 CI 基础设施以加速开发迭代。
items.summary_en: llama.cpp and ggml have released v1.0.0, establishing stable API and ABI boundaries through semantic versioning to support the growing ecosystem of downstream developers. The project supports over 150 model architecture variants and utilizes dedicated backends to run multi-modal LLMs on diverse hardware, including consumer devices and enterprise servers, with infrastructure scaling supported by Hugging Face technologies and hardware partners such as NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel.

items.title: 刚刚，Fable 5.2登顶RoboColiseum新榜单
items.summary: RoboColiseum新赛季公布成绩，Claude Fable 5.2以18.30分综合第一，在精细操作（33.04分）和跨本体迁移（17.99分）中领先，但灵巧手赛道得分仅为3.73分，暴露出多指协同控制的共同短板；相比之下，策略模型π₀.₅在灵巧手赛道以16.79分领跑，超越了所有参评Agent。新榜单通过隐藏测试集、动态抽检和人工审核三重防Hack机制，以及96.86%的仿真-真机一致性验证，确保了评测可信度，并为策略模型在灵巧控制领域超越大模型Agent提供了明确方向。
items.summary_en: Claude Fable 5.2 leads the new RoboColiseum season with a composite score of 18.30, topping the Fine Manipulation (33.04) and Cross-Embodiment (17.99) tracks, while policy model π₀.₅ dominates the Dexterous Hand track at 16.79. The updated benchmark introduces four new tracks, 50 real-world tasks, and a triple anti-hacking mechanism—combining hidden test sets, dynamic spot-checks, and manual review—that achieved a 96.86% simulation-to-real-world consistency rate. To prevent memorization and ensure efficiency, Agents are evaluated on execution step limits and intermediate progress, with dedicated leaderboards separating them from pure policy models like VLA and WAM.

items.title: 以智能体视角，清华首发具身智能综述：从端到端策略到自主系统
items.summary: 清华大学团队发布具身智能综述，提出Agentic Embodied Intelligence（AEI）框架及L0—L5自主性分级标准，将VLA、世界动作模型等通用策略纳入在线认知闭环系统。该研究明确了感知、规划、动作与反思的四项核心功能，并指出云边端协同计算、跨任务经验更新及面向自主性的五类评测情境，是实现从技能学习到开放世界持续自主任务执行的关键路径。
items.summary_en: Tsinghua University released a survey on Agentic Embodied Intelligence (AEI) that integrates multimodal foundation models with computational infrastructure to enable task-level autonomous organization, where systems actively acquire information, manage subtasks, and adjust strategies based on physical feedback. The framework defines an autonomy scale from L0 to L5 based on human-machine responsibility allocation, and proposes "Agentic Embodied Experience" to log decision rationales and physical outcomes for verifying skill recovery and cross-task updates. Key technical challenges include coordinating cloud-edge-device latency constraints, implementing safety checks across perception and control loops, and designing evaluation protocols that isolate specific cognitive capabilities like active understanding and long-horizon planning.

items.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
items.summary: XYBench 是一项包含 8,115 个真实问题的基准测试，旨在评估 AI 助手识别用户“XY 问题”（即基于错误假设提问）并纠正其根本误解的能力，该研究荣获 EMNLP 2026 最佳资源论文奖。测试对比了 Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5 等五大模型，结果显示这些模型均倾向于针对用户表面的错误方案（Y）提供解答，而未能像人类参考答案那样有效识别隐含目标（X）并将用户引导至更优的解决方案，揭示了当前大语言模型在务实语用理解上的显著短板。
items.summary_en: XYBench is a benchmark of 8,115 real-world questions that tests whether AI assistants can identify and correct user misconceptions (the "XY problem") rather than just answering the stated request. Evaluations revealed that major models, including Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3.5-9B, and DeepSeek-V4 Pro, frequently fail to redirect users toward the actual underlying goal, instead sticking to the flawed approach explicitly requested. The dataset, built from sources including Stack Overflow and WikiHow, measures model performance across three metrics: pragmatic solution, pragmatic emphasis, and overall effectiveness in troubleshooting based on context.

items.title: 腾讯混元发布实时语音模型 Hy Realtime，新增工具调用与唱歌能力
items.summary: 腾讯混元发布实时语音模型 Hy Realtime，在保留语音理解与拟人化表达基础上，新增了 Agentic 工具调用及唱歌能力。该模型已落地于元宝语音通话与腾讯客服，并计划近期通过腾讯云提供 API 服务。
items.summary_en: Tencent's Hunyuan team has released the Hy Realtime voice model, which adds agentic tool calling and singing capabilities to its existing features of voice understanding, instruction following, and natural expression. The model is already integrated into Yuanbao voice calls and Tencent customer service, with API access planned for Tencent Cloud in the near future.

items.title: Nvidia enters life without Jensen Huang
AI 录音硬件卖的是时间差，窗口可能只剩半年
items.summary: 苹果在 iOS 27.3 测试版中为 Apple Watch 加入 Live Rewind 和 Siri Recap 功能，虽暂不面向中国提供，但加速了 AI 录音硬件从独立设备向手机系统内置功能演替，预计 2027 年年中将有国产厂商将该能力整合进操作系统，独立硬件的生存窗口期仅剩约半年。当前市场呈现“只留文字、不存音频”趋势，Plaud 累计销量超 300 万台且国内千问 QwenNote A2 等竞品主打云端转写即删，但硬件公司仍面临腾讯 WorkBuddy 等巨头通过 9 款联名硬件抢占入口的竞争，核心壁垒已从录音本身转向谁能拥有读取并筛选个人上下文的 Agent 入口。
items.summary_en: Apple's recent addition of Live Rewind and Siri Recap to Apple Watch threatens the standalone AI recording hardware market, a trend that coincides with major players like Plaud (3 million units sold) and DingTalk competing in a sector where privacy-focused features now prioritize text-only outputs over audio storage. As the market pivots to "Personal AI," companies like Meta and ByteDance are developing dedicated hardware to capture offline context for Agents, while smartphone manufacturers are expected to integrate full-day recording capabilities into their operating systems by mid-2027, narrowing the window for independent hardware startups.

items.title: 研究报告称中国最强 AI 模型使用了被禁出口的 Nvidia Blackwell 芯片训练
items.summary: 非营利组织 Unemployment Labs 通过分析模型权重发现，DeepSeek V4 与 Moonshot Kimi K3 等中国前沿 AI 模型带有 Nvidia Blackwell 芯片的训练痕迹，证实这些被禁出口的芯片已流入中国。研究指出，走私渠道及马来西亚离岸算力中心是关键路径，2024 年至 2025 年约有 200 万枚先进芯片通过此类手段进入中国，其中马来西亚进口了 27.5 万枚加速器。这一发现加剧了英伟达的合规风险，其 CEO 黄仁勋被指与涉嫌走私芯片的 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 存在私人及商业关联，导致公司面临巨大的法律与声誉压力。
items.summary_en: A study by Unemployment Labs found that leading Chinese open-source models, including DeepSeek V4 and Kimi K3, contain digital fingerprints indicating they were trained on export-banned Nvidia Blackwell chips, despite US restrictions. An estimated 200,000 Nvidia AI accelerators entered Malaysia in 2024–2025 to facilitate this offshore computing access, while approximately 2 million advanced chips were smuggled into China over the same period via channels linked to Megaspeed and its CEO Alice Huang.

items.title: 在快 AI 时代，我是怎么把 Mole 做成一款「慢产品」的？
items.summary: Mole 通过实测 853 款 Mac 软件和 30 余款 AI 工具（包括 Claude、Codex 等），补全了 13 类通用清理规则及 90 多条精确路径，并针对 AI 工具生成的巨大缓存（如单文件 62GB 的 opencode.db）实现了按保留周期清理会话与压缩数据库的功能；同时，产品新增了 Mac 系统数据清理模块，通过直接监测磁盘实际变化而非依赖 Apple 估算值，解决了壁纸渲染缓存堆积和 APFS 快照释放滞后等痛点，使该独立产品从 1.13 迭代至 1.19 并发布了 Windows 版，GitHub Star 数达 73.9K。

items.title: What Reddit Reviews Reveals About Your Products via @sejournal, @brentcsutoras
items.summary: Reddit 于 11 月 10 日启动“Reddit Reviews”功能测试，目前覆盖美国英语用户及约 1 万个电子产品、美妆、家居及服装类商品，计划于 2027 年扩展至更多国家和地区。该功能通过 AI 汇总用户关于产品优缺点及竞品对比的讨论，虽无需品牌付费即可获得曝光，但因缺乏购买验证且 AI 可能遗漏上下文，其情感分析结果仅反映部分社区观点而非确切转化率。营销人员应将此作为监测用户期待与体验差异、识别未被追踪的竞品对比场景的渠道，而非直接的销售归因依据。

directions.name: MCP 认证网关
directions.description: 为开发者和企业提供一个标准化的中间件服务，自动处理 MCP 服务器的 OAuth 2.0 认证流程，简化 AI Agent 对电商等 API 的访问权限管理。
directions.description_en: A standardized middleware service for developers and enterprises that automatically handles OAuth 2.0 authentication flows for MCP servers, simplifying AI Agent access to e-commerce and other APIs.
directions.target_user: 需要让 AI Agent 安全访问第三方电商 API 的独立开发者与初创团队
directions.target_user_en: Indie developers and startup teams needing secure AI Agent access to third-party e-commerce APIs
core_features: 无代码配置 OAuth 凭证管理
Token 自动刷新与过期预警
core_features_en: Auto token refresh and expiration alerts
directions.why_now: MCP 正在被 3 个主要技术源报道，显示其从实验阶段进入落地期。DEV Community 上的文章展示了 Next.js/Vercel 架构下的 MCP OAuth 实现痛点，社区讨论显示开发者在‘如何让 AI 合法访问用户数据’上缺乏统一标准。此时提供认证网关可填补基础设施空白。
directions.why_now_en: MCP is being reported by 3 major tech sources, indicating a shift from experimentation to production. An article on DEV Community demonstrates MCP OAuth implementation challenges with Next.js/Vercel, and community discussions highlight a lack of unified standards for 'how to legally access user data via AI'. Providing an auth gateway now fills a critical infrastructure gap.
directions.monetization: SaaS 订阅制（按 API 调用量或坐席收费），企业版提供 SSO 支持
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription (charged by API calls or seats), Enterprise edition with SSO support
directions.source_article: How we built a shopping MCP server with OAuth on Next.js and Vercel
